verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant in a backend platform's console is a fair axis, so this story applies to Appwrite. The evidence only shows ways for external agents to operate on Appwrite: an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, Skills files, plugins, and llms.txt. It also mentions AI building blocks such as vector search and image labeling. None of this is a first-party assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to, so these adjacent capabilities earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
